what: When the cursor moves over a work card, the photo or video inside shifts toward the cursor by (distance from center ÷ 20) in 4px steps, and tilts by the horizontal distance ratio × 2° in 1° steps (.05s linear, so it jerks rather than glides). When the cursor leaves, with no transition, it returns to place in five steps cut every 42ms.

options.div: Push divisor — cursor distance ÷ this value, default 20
options.rot: Tilt at the card edge (degrees), default 2 — at 0 there is no tilt
options.back-steps: Number of cells to loop back, default 5
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Inner image that shifts and tilts

from.where: index.html .project-item a · list.html .c-column-item a — original IndexMain(ye=20 · Re=4 · ei=2 · ft=1 · on exit 5 steps × 42ms)

note: Not applied on touch devices or with reduced motion
